events.text:
**Features shipped last 4 days:**

1. **Portless HTTPS support** - devkit with `--portless` flag for local HTTPS
2. **Entity extraction from chat** - extract entities from user messages
3. **Entity aliases** - capture access patterns as shortcuts for search
4. **Phases 61-64** - link resolution, relation types, cold extraction, document pass
5. **Slack knowledge sync** - durable workflow wrapping Slack sync
6. **Document reprocess** - durable workflow routing
7. **Feature flag service** - Effect-native FeatureFlagService consolidation
8. **Knowledge table redesign** - Phase 1 UI overhaul
9. **Clickable evidence rows** - source navigation in entity panel
10. **Knowledge Intelligence** - Phases 54-60 v1.10 release
11. **Entity Graph** - v1.9 with extraction, dedup, query, ACL, lineage
12. **Structured log viewer** - Phase 3, removed PG task logger
13. **Pipeline perf** - fast chunking + parallel summarization + batch embedding
14. **Multi-runner support** - HttpRunner for cluster mode
15. **BM25/HNSW indexes** - search optimization migrations
16. **K8s setup** - local k3s/k3d cluster for testing

args.description: Count lines of code shipped in last 4 days
List commit messages from last 4 days

args.command:
git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty=tformat:"%s" --no-merges | grep -E "^docs|^chore:" | while read commit; do
  hash=$(git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty="%H" --no-merges | grep -F "$commit" | head -1)
done

# Better approach - get commits by type and sum their diffs
for type in docs chore; do
  echo "=== $type ==="
  git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty="%H" --no-merges | while read hash; do
    msg=$(git log -1 --pretty="%s" $hash)
    if [[ "$msg" == "$type("* ]] || [[ "$msg" == "$type:"* ]]; then
      git show --pretty=tformat: --numstat $hash | awk '{ add += $1; subs += $2 } END { printf "Added: %s, Removed: %s\n", add, subs }'
    fi
  done | awk '/Added:/ { add += $2; subs += $5 } END { printf "Total - Added: %s, Removed: %s, Net: %s\n", add, subs, add-subs }'
done

state.title: List commit messages from last 4 days

toolCalls.commandText:
git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty=tformat:"%s" --no-merges | grep -E "^docs|^chore:" | while read commit; do
  hash=$(git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty="%H" --no-merges | grep -F "$commit" | head -1)
done

# Better approach - get commits by type and sum their diffs
for type in docs chore; do
  echo "=== $type ==="
  git log --since="4 days ago" --pretty="%H" --no-merges | while read hash; do
    msg=$(git log -1 --pretty="%s" $hash)
    if [[ "$msg" == "$type("* ]] || [[ "$msg" == "$type:"* ]]; then
      git show --pretty=tformat: --numstat $hash | awk '{ add += $1; subs += $2 } END { printf "Added: %s, Removed: %s\n", add, subs }'
    fi
  done | awk '/Added:/ { add += $2; subs += $5 } END { printf "Total - Added: %s, Removed: %s, Net: %s\n", add, subs, add-subs }'
done
